questions.question: Satan rose up against Israel and stirred King David to do what?
When the LORD offered King David three punishments through the seer Gad, which did David choose?

answers.text: To fall into the hand of the LORD
To fall into the hands of his enemies
To face three years of famine

questions.question: During a plague on Israel, the LORD saw an angel destroying Jerusalem and let the angel keep going. True or false?
After the plague stopped, what did King David say would stand on Ornan's threshing floor?

answers.text: The house of the LORD God
